title: Indian Outfits for Winter Weddings Abroad: Layering Tips
excerpt: How to stay warm at a winter Indian wedding in the UK, USA or Canada without hiding your outfit – fabrics, layers and smart tricks.
body:
Winter weddings abroad can be cold – but you don't have to cover your outfit with a puffer jacket. Here are easy ways to stay warm and look elegant.

## Choose richer fabrics

Taffeta silk, velvet and heavier silks hold warmth better than light cotton. A taffeta Anarkali with full sleeves is both festive and cosy.

## Layer smartly underneath

A thin thermal top and leggings under your kurta or Anarkali add warmth without bulk. Choose skin-tone or matching colours.

## Add a statement shawl

A pashmina or embroidered shawl looks beautiful draped over an Anarkali and keeps you warm outdoors.

## Try a long jacket or cape

A long jacket in a matching colour can be worn over a kurta set and removed indoors for photos.

## Warm footwear

Carry your heels and wear warm boots to the venue. Change when you arrive.

## Order early

December and January are busy months for couriers, so order your wedding outfit at least four weeks ahead.
